component.name: Systemd Manager
component.summary: Start, stop, enable and inspect systemd services

description.p: Systemd Manager is a desktop app for the services on your computer. It lists every system and user service, updates live when they change, and lets you control them without a terminal.

ul.li: Start, stop, restart, reload, enable, disable, mask and unmask services
See why a service failed, with its exit code, CPU, memory and restarts
Follow the journal live, pause it, search it, filter it by priority, boot or time, and save it
Edit unit files with syntax highlighting; vendor units get a drop-in override that you can revert
Create services from a form, optionally run on a schedule with a timer
See all timers with their next and last run

description.p: Changes to system services ask for your password through polkit.

ul.li: Edits to vendor units are saved as drop-in overrides, with Show Original and Revert to Vendor
Asks before discarding unsaved unit file edits, and before risky actions on system services
Delete services you created
Journal filters (priority, boot, time range) and saving the log to a file
Why a service failed, CPU time, tasks, restarts, and Reset Failed
Timers list, and scheduled services with a timer from the New service form
Command checks, environment variables, ExecStop and all restart policies in the New service form
Resources tab with live CPU and memory graphs and the service's processes, heaviest first
Sort the service list by CPU or memory use
CPU and memory figures explained the way other system monitors show them
One password prompt for each save of a system unit file
Preferences for light or dark style and the interface and monospace fonts
Faster service list, keyboard shortcuts, and syntax highlighting for unit files
Reconnects by itself when the system bus restarts
